findings.behaviour: Generates unattend XML disabling all three guest firewall profiles, includes plaintext domain join credentials and reversibly base64-encodes the local administrator password.
findings.replacement: Keep guest firewalls enabled. Separate per-role credentials, approved encrypted/short-lived provisioning-secret handling and cleanup. Base64 is not encryption.

findings.behaviour: Sets domain complexity false and minimum password length zero, then configures non-expiring/non-changeable accounts.
findings.replacement: Preserve a strong domain policy and define credential lifecycle. Do not run this helper unchanged.

findings.behaviour: Enables broad CredSSP delegation and runs downloaded Chocolatey code through Invoke-Expression.
findings.replacement: Exclude optional Admin Center/Chocolatey/UI tooling from bootstrap. Use supported PowerShell Direct for owned local Hyper-V guests with explicit guest credentials.

findings.behaviour: Sets wildcard TrustedHosts and enables network PowerShell remoting on management guest.
findings.replacement: Use PowerShell Direct where supported, no wildcard TrustedHosts, no added network remoting listener by assumption.

findings.behaviour: Installs an unpinned AD prerequisite module and forwards the current ARM token into nested nodes for Arc registration.
findings.replacement: Pin and inspect transitive dependencies. Approve an exact registration identity and secure token delivery/lifetime without logs, disk persistence or implicit operator credential reuse.

findings.behaviour: Creates a fixed-name disk/VM set without complete repeat guards and configures automatic guest start.
findings.replacement: Validate existing resource identities and disk state, journal each phase, default nested automatic start off until the exact network/security design is accepted.

conclusion: A package version/hash pin does not make the implementation safe. Replacing only the top-level Bootstrap.ps1 would leave these nested side effects in place.
